howto.name: Paste your CSV or JSON
howto.text: Or upload a file. Auto-detects the format.

howto.name: Click Convert
howto.text: CSV → JSON: each row becomes an object using the first row as keys. JSON → CSV: array of objects → rows; keys → header.

howto.name: Copy or download the result
howto.text: Runs entirely in your browser. Your data never leaves your device.

faq.a: Standard RFC 4180: commas in values must be quoted; quotes inside values are doubled (""). PrivaTools handles both.
Nested objects are flattened to dot-notation columns (user.name, user.email) for CSV output. Reverse direction reconstructs the nesting.
No — pure-browser conversion. No data leaves your machine.
